name: Anzen USDz
oneLiner: USDz is Anzen's RWA dollar backed mainly by Percent-underwritten U.S. private credit (SPCT), plus a Superstate tokenized-T-bill and cash sleeve.
collateral: Primarily diversified U.S. private credit assets (SMB merchant receivables, factored invoices, PO financing, auto lease financing, consumer installment lending) tokenized as Secured Private Credit Tokens (SPCT) underwritten by Percent (U.S.-licensed broker-dealer), alongside a Superstate USTB/USCC tokenized-Treasury sleeve and a cash buffer
pegMechanism: Each USDz backed 1:1 by its reserve basket — majority SPCT private credit plus a Superstate USTB/USCC tokenized-Treasury sleeve and cash — locked in the smart contract; peg maintained by arbitrage — if below $1, traders buy at discount; if above $1, Qualified Market Makers mint at 1:1 USDz/USDC and sell

applicabilityBasis.summary: USDz is a private-credit-backed RWA dollar with permissioned QMM mint/redeem mechanics; Anzen Group Ltd explicitly blocks US persons (prohibited jurisdiction in ToS) and holds no regulatory authorization in any jurisdiction, making GENIUS payment-stablecoin applicability unresolved.

genius.notes: USDz is stablecoin-adjacent but backed by private credit; GENIUS payment-stablecoin applicability is unresolved. The ToS explicitly excludes US persons and states Anzen Group Ltd is not registered with any regulatory body in any jurisdiction. No GENIUS PPSI approval, state-qualified approval, application, or foreign-issuer exception evidence found.

mintAuthority.summary: USDz is minted when SPCT holders call deposit() or depositBySPCT() on the USDz contract; the contract is permissioned via AccessControl roles. DEFAULT_ADMIN is a 6-owner 2/6 GnosisSafe (Safe v1.3, no modules, no guard). POOL_MANAGER_ROLE is held by a separate GnosisSafeProxy (0x604e831…). Earlier admin addresses (0x3def017, 0x20b15ee) had both DEFAULT_ADMIN and POOL_MANAGER_ROLE revoked.

controls.label: SPCT deposit mint (user-callable, SPCT-gated)
controls.capDescription: deposit() and depositBySPCT() are callable by any holder of the permissioned SPCT token; mint supply is bounded by SPCT availability (issuer-controlled RWA).
controls.evidence: Blockscout ABI shows deposit(uint256) and depositBySPCT(uint256) on the USDz contract with no role guard visible in the ABI — supply expansion is bounded by SPCT access, which is issuer-controlled.
